method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (qlt-core.l4, with 11 regulative rules for the duties the Land Tax Act and the Taxation Administration Act put on the owner, the person, the taxpayer and the Commissioner, each named as its text names it, and core functions for every test, deadline and date the seat gives) and a seat layer (qlt-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (trustee and company owners, including under s 53, and multi-parcel homes answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate. Corrected on 2026-10-24 after an independent verification (NOTES.md findings 21-24 and the corrections list).
edition_encoded: Land Tax Act 2010 (Qld) (act-2010-015), version in force from 2025-08-01, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2010-015.txt; Land Tax Regulation 2021 (sl-2021-0019), in force from 2023-07-01, deposited at ../../../land-tax-regulation-2021/registers/source-bundle/sl-2021-0019.txt (ss 2 and 4); Taxation Administration Act 2001 (Qld) (act-2001-072), in force from 2025-02-28, deposited at ../../../taxation-administration-act-2001/registers/source-bundle/act-2001-072.txt (ss 28, 30, 54, 58, 63-65, 67-69); all retrieved 2026-10-20 from the Queensland Legislation HTML view (unofficial). Inputs not deposited: the s 18(2) averaging factor (formula lost in the deposit), Land Valuation Act values, the TAA prescribed interest rate and weekday (Taxation Administration Regulation 2022).

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run qlt-core.l4 ; l4 run qlt-seat.l4 ; l4 run qlt-cases-owner.l4
checks.result: 210 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24, after the corrections); 11 #TRACEs with an expect line (9 breaches, 2 obligations still owed), each read and as expected; control copies with 2 altered expected values (before and after the corrections) each reported exactly 2 failures
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the individual land owner: Land Tax Act 2010 ss 6-8; s 9; ss 10, 11, 13, 14; ss 16-18 (averaging factor an input); s 19; s 22(1)-(3); s 23 (the s 23(5) exemption only for land taken to be owned by the deceased person under s 23(4)(a)); s 31; s 32(1)(a), (c) with Schedule 1 and Schedule 3 as tables; s 34; ss 35-42B (home: 6 month residency, care, renovation, principal place of residence, non-exempt purpose, allowable lettings, work from home, whole and partial exemption, moving); ss 44, 44A; s 53(1), (2)(a), (3) with Regulation s 2 (trustee and company owners not covered: s 53(2)(b)-(d) out); ss 59, 60; ss 70-74 with Regulation s 4; ss 76, 77, 77A; s 81. Taxation Administration Act 2001 ss 28, 30(1)(e), (2), 54, 58, 63-65, 67-69 as they apply to land tax. Out: companies and trustees (Schedule 2, ss 20, 22A, 24, 33, 43), foreign surcharge, s 22(4)-(7), home unit companies, time-sharing, ss 18A, 29, 30, 45, charitable and other Division 3 exemptions, Part 6A build-to-rent, Part 7A windfall tax, Part 8 avoidance, ss 75, 78, 79, Division 2A, Part 10, other TAA machinery. Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991/ (s 11 homeowner; s 11A principal home and its absence rules, s 11A(8), (9)) and subjects/au/income-tax-assessment-act-1997/ (Subdivision 118-B main residence), kept apart from s 36; cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seats: the individual land owner (home owner, owner of other land, or absentee owner)
